subject: ela
cluster: Research to build and present knowledge
intro: Pick the best answer about shared projects.

items.prompt:
To learn about bugs, where should the class look?
A) In a book about bugs
B) In a lunchbox
C) In a shoe
items.answer: A) In a book about bugs

steps: Books have facts. Key is A.
solution.answer: A) In a book about bugs

items.prompt:
A shared project is done:
A) Alone
B) Together
C) Never

To learn more, we ask:
A) Questions
B) Nothing
C) For candy

steps: Ask to learn. Key is A.

items.prompt:
The class is studying the weather. A good book to read is about:
A) Trucks
B) Weather
C) Shoes

steps: Match the topic. Key is B.

items.prompt:
After we learn facts, we should:
A) Share them
B) Forget them
C) Hide them

steps: Share what we learned. Key is A.

items.prompt:
In a group project, each person should:
A) Take turns and help
B) Do nothing
C) Take all the work

steps: Share the work. Key is A.

items.prompt:
Your class wants facts about the ocean. The BEST first step is to:
A) Read a book about the ocean
B) Guess the facts
C) Study trucks
items.answer: A) Read a book about the ocean

steps: Find facts in a matching book. Key is A.
solution.answer: A) Read a book about the ocean

items.prompt:
Why do we SHARE what we learned in a project?
A) So others can learn too
B) To keep it secret
C) To waste time
items.answer: A) So others can learn too

steps: Sharing teaches the group. Key is A.
solution.answer: A) So others can learn too
